assessment_methods.method: Continuous assessment: Written and/or Oral and/or Deliverable and/or practical

assessment_rules: For the main session, evaluation is based on continuous assessment, comprising one deliverable (coefficient 0.2) and at least four other components (coefficient 0.8) which can be written, oral, deliverable, or practical. For the resit session (second chance), there will be one written and/or oral and/or deliverable and/or practical component, and the lowest grade from the initial evaluation of the UE will be neutralized.
degree: Licence Sciences pour l'ingénieur — Génie mécanique (parcours Mécanique), UFR ST
